agency: Washington State Housing Finance Commission (Here to Home)

programs.name: Home Advantage Downpayment Assistance

amount.text: 3%, 4% or 5% of the first-mortgage loan amount at 0% interest

programs.repayment: no monthly payments; due when you sell, refinance or transfer, stop living there, or pay off the home (at 30 years or before)
programs.quote: Offers 3%, 4%, or 5% of the first-mortgage loan amount in downpayment assistance at 0% interest. Statewide income limit = $215,000

programs.name: Home Advantage Needs-Based DPA

amount.text: up to $10,000 at 1% simple interest, for homes under $250,000

programs.repayment: deferred, due on sale, refinance, transfer or payoff

incomeLimit.text: the page shows two figures: $164,400 King/Snohomish and $126,800 other counties in the summary, $157,100 / $122,100 in the eligibility section

programs.name: House Key Opportunity DPA
programs.repayment: deferred, due on sale, refinance, transfer or payoff

incomeLimit.text: King/Snohomish $93,350 (1-2 persons) / $116,650 (3+); Clark, Kitsap, Pierce, Skamania $83,000 / $103,700; Thurston, Whatcom $78,600 / $98,250; all other counties $67,450 / $84,300

programs.name: Covenant Homeownership Program

amount.text: up to 20% of the cost of the home, up to $150,000, plus closing costs

programs.firstTimeNote: people (and descendants) who lived in Washington before April 1968 and belonged to groups affected by housing discrimination

incomeLimit.text: $164,400 King and Snohomish, $126,800 all other counties

local.name: ARCH (East King County)
local.text: up to $30,000 at 4% simple interest; price limits $660,000 new / $646,000 existing; 4-person income limit $116,650; buyer contributes 2%

local.name: Bellingham DPA
